title: Complete dyadic helper bases without an individual unit pivot
body:
This enabling algorithm completes the dyadic helper-basis interface used by [PR #5602](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5602). For every dyadic row a and column b with a*b=1, it constructs R with aR=e_p and Re_p=b using ADD and dyadic-unit SCALE operations. The existing unit-entry test omits legal pairs such as a=(3,5), b=(2,-1). **Complete kappa is unchanged.**

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c132f93acaee6dd8d5ee5006da0670dfef3e9362/research/dyadic-helper-basis-completion/PROOF.md), [compiler](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c132f93acaee6dd8d5ee5006da0670dfef3e9362/research/dyadic-helper-basis-completion/basis.py), [verification and receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c132f93acaee6dd8d5ee5006da0670dfef3e9362/research/dyadic-helper-basis-completion/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c132f93acaee6dd8d5ee5006da0670dfef3e9362/research/dyadic-helper-basis-completion/SOURCES.json). Base: canonical main d7633ce230196a1d5d061347de7a0fd8be512ed6, priority 7. The consumed source files equal PR5602 head 6c224aa720203c4f4615e6538d8038a275387db8.

Normal and optimized registered checks pass. A separate dense interpreter checks all 18 published basis interfaces, 616 complete small-pair compilations, 96 larger dyadic presentations and the inverse identities. The small census contains 16 legal pairs omitted by the old test. Five invalid inputs and an operation-sign defect are rejected. Committed-byte and Git-free export checks pass.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dyadic-helper-basis-completion
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Expected scientific marker: `PASS_DYADIC_HELPER_BASIS_COMPLETION`; expected launcher marker: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

No new physical cut, target inventory, native map or full caller is claimed. Installation must charge scalar work and recheck coefficient growth, operation count, tape costs and the complete invoice. The selected cold replay, full source-history ancestry, physical/native/compiler/outer replay and independent human or formal review were not run. The checkout is shallow. Hosted CI is separate.

Credit Ali Romman's [PR #5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599) and PR5602 for helper splitting and the dual-pair interface, and their retained P104/native/controller/compiler lineage. Nick Petalas already used Euclidean row preparation for a different single-hub shear in [PR #5115](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5115). This interface prescribes both the row and column. The Euclidean method is standard; no new general algebra theorem is claimed. [Scoped coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19184390) excludes active construction searches. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
